brand_archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO / COMMAND CENTER HYBRID

typography.hierarchy_rules: Max heading text-4xl to text-5xl on desktop. Keep jumps between sizes to max 2 Tailwind steps.

colors.rules: No full-screen gradients. Do not use teal green (#1B93A4) per E1 rules. Do not use complete transparent backgrounds in overlays.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Flat Solid surfaces with 1px subtle borders (border-white/10). No muddy gray transparency.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Ambient diffuse shadows for floating elements, otherwise flat for data density.
visual_enhancers.badges: Use highly legible pills with 10% opacity backgrounds of their respective colors and 100% opacity text.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid strokes to separate elements in dark mode.

grids_and_layouts.dashboard_mode: High Density Grid. Base grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. Gap-4 to gap-6. Every pixel utilized. h-full on children.
grids_and_layouts.mobile: Tables convert to Cards. Detail views use Bottom Sheets (Drawers).
grids_and_layouts.desktop: Left-side navigation (w-64). Structured dashboard, side-by-side context panels.

motion_and_interactions.hover: Explicit text color on hover. Row highlights in tables. Lift (-translate-y-1) on cards.
motion_and_interactions.transitions: Specific transitions only (e.g., transition-colors, transition-transform). Never transition-all.
motion_and_interactions.loading: Skeleton loaders matching the dark mode surface color. Subtle pulse.

components.name: Badge
components.instructions: Use for statuses: Detected (Blue), Draft Ready (Purple), Needs Approval (Amber), Approved (Mint), Sent (Gray), Replied (Purple), Appointment Booked (Mint). Use soft backgrounds with bright text.

components.name: Tables
components.instructions: Data-dense but readable. Use 1px bottom borders for rows. Convert to vertical stack cards on mobile. Left align tabular data.

components.name: Drawer / Sheet
components.instructions: Use for the Customer Revenue Memory profile on mobile and slide-outs on desktop. Ensure strong solid backgrounds, not transparent.

components.name: Charts
components.instructions: Use Recharts. Minimalist axes. Lines should use the Mint and Purple accents.

pages_and_views.name: Demo Entry / Login
pages_and_views.layout: Centered card over dark abstract navy texture. Button: 'Enter Demo Workspace'.

pages_and_views.name: Revenue Pulse Dashboard
pages_and_views.layout: KPI cards top row (Revenue at Risk, Recovered, Appointments booked, Follow-ups due, Response speed). Opportunity trend chart spanning 2-3 columns. Agent activity feed and Needs Approval list widget.

pages_and_views.name: Opportunity Inbox
pages_and_views.layout: Tabs for categories (New Leads, Missed Calls, Open Estimates, Repeat Customers). Search/filter bar. Data table/cards with status badges.

pages_and_views.name: Customer Revenue Memory Profile
pages_and_views.layout: Split view: Timeline/Audit on one side, Opportunity card (AI rationale, draft preview, value) on the other. Includes 'Needs Approval' CTA.

pages_and_views.name: Approval Center
pages_and_views.layout: High-trust review workspace. Side-by-side or focused layout showing proposed message, workflow name, reasoning vs customer context. Large accessible Approval actions.

pages_and_views.name: Workflow Builder
pages_and_views.layout: Stack of editable configuration panels (Trigger conditions, Business hours, Contact channel, Message tone, Follow-up timing, Approval mode, Stop rules). NOT drag-and-drop.

pages_and_views.name: Impact Report
pages_and_views.layout: Comparison selectors, split metrics (Estimated/Modeled vs Recorded), Methodology info panel, simulated export.

pages_and_views.name: Settings
pages_and_views.layout: Minimalist layout with a 'Reset Demo Data' control.

accessibility.contrast: Maintain WCAG AA standards. Use text shadows over images if necessary.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Never use generic AI emojis (🤖🧠💡). Use Lucide icons instead.
Never use transition-all. Target specific properties.
Do not use complete transparent backgrounds for overlays, headers, or dropdowns. Use solid backgrounds like bg-slate-900 or heavy backdrop-blur.
Do not center-align the main App container (.App { text-align: center; } is strictly forbidden).
Enforce generous padding: Use p-6, p-8 inside cards, keeping text away from borders.
Include the persistent 'Demo Mode — Fictional Data' badge in the main header of the dashboard layout.
Build custom interactive UI with standard HTML + Tailwind where Shadcn isn't required, but use Shadcn for standard form inputs, dialogs, drawers, and tabs.
Always wrap dynamic route/state changes with subtle enter animations.
instructions_to_main_agent: Start by generating the common Layout containing the Left Navigation and the Top Header (which includes the Demo Mode badge).
Develop the Revenue Pulse Dashboard using Grid CSS with specific spans for charts and lists.
Use fictional data for 'Northstar Heating & Air' located in Newark, NJ.
Implement the Opportunity Inbox, switching from table on desktop to stacked cards on mobile.
Develop the Approval Center and Workflow Builder using standard forms and stacked panels (no drag and drop).
Ensure the application strictly follows the color palette: Deep Navy (#0A0F1C to #111827), Purple (#7C5CFC), and Mint (#00E5A8).
